messages:
maya_cs: Starting CoralGate week0 onboarding thread. Open items: KMS key approval (CS-8022), partner egress blocked, and audit events not arriving to their Splunk endpoint. Can infra/security own next hops?

linus_infra: I can make the firewall change but need exact CIDR + ports and a short justification for the change request. We'll track change id once applied.

maya_cs: CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 ports 443 (API) and 8088 (Splunk HEC). Justification: partner API + audit ingestion. KMS details: alias/ckeys/coral-prod, ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999:key/ef12-3456. Customer prefers manual rotation for now. Ticket CS-8022 has the draft policy.

tess_security: Security asks that the key policy scope only the redwood service principal and denies Decrypt for interactive users. Also include rotation preference in the request. I'll review the draft in CS-8022 and add comments.

aditya_se: Recommend the customer create cross-account role in their account that grants us s3:GetObject on log prefix. I'll attach a minimal CFN snippet and example trust. Quick connectivity test for Splunk HEC (replace token):

```
curl -v -k https://splunk.coralgate.io:8088/services/collector/event -H 'Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>' -d '{"event":"cg test"}'
```

Post the output if it fails.

ollie_support: Common failures: missing HEC token, HEC not enabled for TLS, or network ACL blocking. Also confirm VPC Flow Logs are writing to s3://coralgate-logs/flow/ and check object timestamps.

opsbot: priv-deploy/coralgate v1.1.0 smoke started at 1799993330. status: partial-success. failed: audit-forwarding

raj_ops: I ran the Splunk curl at 1799993358. Response: HTTP/1.1 204 No Content — success. Forwarder logs show event accepted. Uploading snippets to CS-8022.

maya_cs: Noting renewal sensitivity: AM flagged onboarding velocity as a renewal signal. If KMS approval + sustained audit delivery not confirmed within 72h, escalate to AM and finance and mark as at-risk. Action list: @aditya_se post CFN by EOD; @tess_security finalize key policy; @linus_infra open firewall CR and confirm id; @raj_ops monitor logs for 24h and attach evidence. Follow-up check-in scheduled 1790079900. :white_check_mark:
